JiwaDocument.Name: Link Branch to Warehouse
JiwaDocument.Description:
Allows a Branch to be linked to a warehouse.
When a sales order or sales quote is created, the branch is set to the branch of the active warehouse.
The branch is defined by a custom field against the Logical Warehouse - the user can set this using the Warehouse Maintenance form.
JiwaDocument.Author: Jiwa Financials

CustomField.Name: Branch
CustomField.Description: The branch to use for sales orders
